newsitem.title: FRANCE: French defence minister to visit troops in Africa.
newsitem.headline: French defence minister to visit troops in Africa.

text.p: Defence Minister Charles Millon will inspect French troops based in Chad and Gabon on a three-day trip from Saturday as well as meet leaders of the two African nations, his spokesman said on Thursday.
Millon will visit Chad on Saturday and Sunday and Gabon on Monday, Pierre Servent said.

"These visits follow similar visits he has made to Djibouti, Senegal and the Ivory Coast and confirm the importance which France attaches to Africa and to its traditional friends there," Servent told reporters.

France has maintained several garrisons and thousands of troops in former African colonies for decades. The forces, which have intervened countless times on the continent, have often served to prop up governments friendly to Paris.
